rules.rule_en: A phrasal verb is an idiomatic phrase consisting of verb and another element, typically an adverb or preposition or both, meaning of which is different from meaning of its separate parts.
A phrasal verb is a combination of words (a verb + a preposition or a verb + adverb) that when used together, usually take on a different meaning from that of the original verb.
A phrasal verb is a verb that is made up of a main verb together with an adverb or a preposition, or both.
A combination of words (a verb+a preposition or a verb+adverb) that when used together, usually take on a different meaning from that of the original verb.
